question: What great-seat configuration is defined by an excess of ninety-six units?
premises: An excess of ninety-six is specified.
It is identified as a great seat.
inference: A great seat called śatabhadra is defined with an excess of ninety-six units.
uncertainties: The base number to which ninety-six is added is not explicit in this verse.
plain_english: And indeed, exceeding by ninety-six, there is the great seat called śatabhadra.
